## 2026-11-13T19:45Z Creative render completes end to end for the first time

Run `43483476413` at `49703e58` is the first run where the full creative path passed: reference analysis, authoring, and **Render and repair creative candidates** all report success. The visual-gate retry (`fb71995a`) and the analyzer fixes are working.

The preview build then rejected the candidate, correctly:

- `decision: reject`, `promotionReady: false`
- Hard failure: `contrast fail: / desktop default ... a:nth-of-type(2) text "0598020802" (1.000; required 4.5); foreground #14201d, background variable; overlapping non-ancestor paint requires rendered review, resolved from rendered pixels`
- Plus at least one `contrast unresolved` focus finding

That is a real defect in the authored candidate (a dark ink link over an unmeasured backdrop in the hero), not a template bug. With the preview policy now at one candidate and one repair cycle there is no second candidate to select, so the single defect rejects the render and the run fails before the pack fallback can deploy.

This is the trade the one-candidate policy makes, and it needs a decision: either raise the repair-cycle bound for preview, or let a near-miss candidate deliver with warnings when the only failure is an advisory contrast class that the local design repair can fix after delivery.

### Root cause of the remaining reject

The failing selector sits inside `astro-island`, the hydrated client boundary. `verify-rendered-revision` audits the built page including hydrated islands, while the creative gate judges rendered screenshots. A link inside a hydrated island can therefore pass the creative gate and still fail the final whole-page contrast audit, which is what happened: the candidate's hero phone link measured 1.000 against an unmeasured backdrop.

`contrast fail` stays hard (a 1.000 ratio means invisible text, which is critical accessibility), while `contrast unresolved` is already advisory. The correct fix is to make the creative gate audit the hydrated page rather than only screenshots, not to downgrade the check.

**Retracted at 21:52Z.** The creative gate already audits the built page through the same
`rendered-contrast.mjs`, so there was no hydrated-island scope gap. The 1.000 was the element's
own border sampled as backdrop; see the 21:52Z entry below.

## 2026-11-13T21:52Z The 1.000 contrast failures were the element's own border

Worktree `.worktrees/launchloom-island-contrast`, branch `codex/launchloom-island-contrast`.

Work OS ledger: not created. The canonical VPS copy is unreachable from this machine
(`ssh -i ~/.ssh/google_compute_engine dev@72.62.5.190` times out on port 22, ICMP 100% loss,
IPv6 `2a02:4780:f:eba3::1` reports network unreachable, retried over roughly an hour).
Recording the work here until the ledger is reachable, then creating the task retroactively.

### Root cause

The creative preview build rejected intake 146 on twelve `contrast fail` lines, six of them
exactly `1.000` with two different foregrounds and six at `1.180`. Reproduced on the real built
page, then in a four-element fixture:

- `0598020802` default: `1.000 #14201d`. The link is `.ll-btn-quiet` with
  `background:#e8eee5; color:#14201d; border:1px solid #14201d`. `resolveRenderedBackdrop`
  captures the element box and measures the worst pixel in it. The 1px border is the same
  colour as the text, so the "backdrop" evaluated equal to the foreground and the ratio
  collapsed to exactly 1.000. The real contrast is 13.2:1.
- `0598020802` hover: `1.000 #e8eee5`, same mechanism inverted (text becomes the pale surface
  colour while the dark fill and border stay).
- `Call now` hover: `1.180 #ffffff`. The element screenshot's clip includes a sliver of the
  surrounding `#e8eee5` panel at the fractional element edge, and white against that panel is
  1.180. The real contrast against the `#027262` hover fill is 5.36:1.

The same element without the border measured 14.187 and the button without the edge sliver
measured 5.856, which isolates the cause. This is not a hydrated-island scope gap: the creative
gate already audits the built page through the same `rendered-contrast.mjs`.

### Fixes

- `scripts/rendered-contrast.mjs`: `analyzePixelBackdrop` gains an edge `inset`, and
  `resolveRenderedBackdrop` re-measures without the element's own painted edge and keeps the
  **better** ratio. Excluding the edge can only rescue a failure, never invent one, so the
  change cannot weaken a genuine finding. A focus ring keeps its own perimeter band. Capture
  errors now log under `LL_CONTRAST_DEBUG=1` instead of vanishing.
- `templates/client-site/src/lib/color-policy.mjs`: the `focus` ring is proved against the
  darkest recurring light band (and lightest dark band), not only its own surface.
- `templates/client-site/src/layouts/SiteLayout.astro`: expose `--ll-focus` on the body. It was
  only emitted inside `[data-ll-surface]` scopes, so platform chrome such as the quick-answers
  launcher fell back to its own hardcoded `#439d8b` ring and measured 2.647:1 against a light
  band. It is now `#348f7e` at 3.024:1 worst case.
